own: I'm actually taking a more lenient approach because on a site I was on called LocalCoinSwap, I would open up six trades at the same time with people and then I would just go with the one who responded first. So basically, message six people, the first one that says, "Yep, I'm here, let's do this," that's the one I worked with. The other ones I closed out. So I don't think there should be any penalty because really, what did that really do to put the buyer out of their way? It didn't. All they did is maybe send a message saying, "Yes, please fund escrow," and they never got a response. Big deal. So no penalty. But actually, one thing though I think we should do is when they do open a trade, one of the rules that will pop up should say, "If you are opening multiple trades with multiple people to see who responds first, please out of respect close out the other trades so at least the other people know that the trade is done and they're not waiting on you and there's not a possibility that there's an opportunity for them." So find some way to word that better through design.
